adversarialFixtures.name: Singular Reference Support (Q_0 = 0, P_0 = 1/2)
adversarialFixtures.takeaway: When Q_b = 0 but P_b > 0, the Q-relative canonical reconstruction R_ref(b,a) = q_a K(a,b)/Q_b has a 0/0 singularity and fails on P (error 2/3), whereas R_mix(b,a) = (p_a+q_a)K(a,b)/(P_b+Q_b) reduces to p_a K(a,b)/P_b and achieves zero error on both P and Q without requiring absolute continuity p ≪ q.
